note: Evaluation-only ground truth for the relationship engine. Pairs were drawn from the completed 3-document run in data/run_delhivery.db (2022 prospectus, FY24 annual report, Q4-FY24 earnings deck). Two sources are mixed: 'existing_rel' pairs already carry a relationships row and are stratified across the system's CONTRADICTS / CORROBORATES / RECONCILED / TEMPORAL_CHANGE buckets plus all 12 UNCERTAIN rows, so they measure precision; 'missed_pair' entries have no relationships row and were found by scanning for equal or scale-equivalent value_norm and for shared subject/predicate tokens across documents, so they measure recall. Every pair was labelled after reading both full fact rows and their evidence text and page numbers. Labelling rules applied uniformly: distinct line items, distinct entities, part-vs-whole relations and coincidentally equal values are UNRELATED; the same metric at different periods is TEMPORAL_CHANGE; the same metric differing by an explicit contextual qualifier (standalone vs consolidated, quarterly vs annual, adjusted vs reported, differing population or lookback window) is RECONCILED; agreeing values for the same metric, period and scope are CORROBORATES even when unit scale (INR million vs INR crore) or rounding differs; CONTRADICTS is reserved for a genuine same-metric, same-period, same-scope numeric disagreement. These labels are evaluation-only ground truth and are never imported by src/; no module under src/ reads this file.
